presentation.summary: Manage changing housekeeping conditions in a busy facility before they develop into injuries.
presentation.situation: A busy facility has temporary deliveries, wet cleaning and maintenance work occurring around shared walkways.
presentation.objective: Make five professional safety decisions as conditions change.
knownFacts: A busy facility has temporary deliveries, wet cleaning and maintenance work occurring around shared walkways.

work_authorization_record.title: Walkway Hazard Record
work_authorization_record.summary: A main pedestrian route is partially obstructed by deliveries while a nearby cleaned surface remains wet.
details: Pedestrians are exposed to both restricted walking space and a slip hazard in the same area.
The delivered materials reduce the usable route width and can encourage people toward the wet surface.
The combined conditions mean the normal walkway cannot be treated as fully available.

control_verification_record.title: Temporary Pedestrian Route Check
control_verification_record.summary: The delivered material cannot be moved immediately, so pedestrian access depends on a temporary route.
details: The temporary path must provide usable width and visibility for the expected pedestrian flow.
People should not have to squeeze past the obstruction or enter another hazard area to continue through the facility.
The route needs clear separation and should remain maintained until the normal walkway is restored.

condition_change_record.title: Cable Route Change Record
condition_change_record.summary: A maintenance cable now crosses the temporary pedestrian path.
details: The cable introduces a new trip hazard into the route selected to avoid the original obstruction.
The temporary path no longer matches the condition that was previously checked for pedestrian use.
Cable routing or protection must be considered before the path can be regarded as safely restored.

response_record.title: Slip Near-Miss Record
response_record.summary: A worker slipped at the edge of the cleaned area but recovered balance without injury.
details: The event demonstrates that the remaining surface and route controls did not fully prevent loss of footing.
The absence of injury does not remove the evidence that the hazard was still active.
Surface condition, pedestrian routing and temporary warnings should be reviewed before continued use.

closeout_record.title: Walkway Restoration Record
closeout_record.summary: The floor is dry and temporary deliveries and cables have been removed.
details: The original pedestrian route can now be inspected for clear width, surface condition and normal access.
Temporary barriers and signs should remain until the route has been confirmed ready for ordinary use.
Reopening should restore the intended layout rather than simply remove the temporary controls.

safe_completion.title: Safe completion
safe_completion.narrative: The work is completed with controls verified.
safe_completion.keyTurningPoint: The key controls were verified before work continued.

controlled_recovery.title: Controlled recovery
controlled_recovery.narrative: Earlier gaps are recognized and corrected before completion.
controlled_recovery.keyTurningPoint: The team recovered by restoring the control boundary.

major_incident.title: Major incident
major_incident.narrative: Unresolved control gaps lead to a significant modeled outcome.
major_incident.keyTurningPoint: Work continued before the required controls were verified.
